content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 3

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 3:1 | "People-of God" | "People of God" | "God's People" | Inscription form | SOPHIA: "People of God" — Hebrew construct 'am 'el rendered with "of" (LOGOS) |
| 2 | 3:2 | "according-to their generations" | "according to their order of birth" | "listed in birth order" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "according to their order of birth" — LOGOS clarifies toledot in context |
| 3 | 3:3 | "Standard-of God" | "Standard of God" | "Banner of God" | Key term | SOPHIA: "Standard of God" — nes/degel as "standard" (military); "banner" too casual |
| 4 | 3:5 | "without-any-remnant" | "leaving no remnant" | "no survivor will remain" | Structural | SOPHIA: "leaving no remnant" — LOGOS participial phrase natural in English |
| 5 | 3:7 | "he shall-not-turn-back his anger" | "he shall not turn back his anger" | "he will not relent" | Interpretive | SOPHIA: "he shall not relent" — PNEUMA's verb captures sense; EMET/LOGOS too wooden |
| 6 | 3:8-9 | "all flesh-of wickedness" | "all wicked flesh" | "all evil humanity" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "all wicked flesh" — LOGOS preserves basar idiom; PNEUMA too interpretive |
| 7 | 3:10 | "Ended is the stand-of wickedness" | "The stand of wickedness has ended" | "Evil's last stand is over, shattered" | Structural | SOPHIA: "The stand of wickedness has ended" — LOGOS; PNEUMA adds "shattered" |
| 8 | 3:11 | "Songs-of-joy for God" | "Songs of joy to God" | "Joyful songs to God" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "Songs of joy to God" — LOGOS; preserves noun construct |
| 9 | 3:12 | "the nine men-of his command" | "the nine men under his command" | "the nine men in his unit" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the nine men under his command" — LOGOS preferred |
| 10 | 3:13 | "the whole order-of their names" | "the full order of their names" | "the complete roster of names" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the full order of their names" — LOGOS; PNEUMA's "roster" too modern |
| 11 | 3:14 | "Tumult-of God" | "Tumult of God" | "God's Battle Roar" | Inscription | SOPHIA: "Tumult of God" — LOGOS literal; PNEUMA interprets mehuman freely |
| 12 | 3:14 | "Slain-ones-of God" | "Slain of God" | "God's Fallen Foes" | Inscription | SOPHIA: "Slain of God" — LOGOS preserves Hebrew; PNEUMA adds "Foes" |
| 13 | 3:15 | "Exaltation-of God" | "Exaltation of God" | "God Exalted" | Inscription form | SOPHIA: "Exaltation of God" — construct form consistent with other inscriptions |
| 14 | 3:15 | "Praises-of God" | "Praises of God" | "Praise to God" | Inscription | SOPHIA: "Praises of God" — LOGOS; maintains plural tehillot |
| 15 | 3:17 | "Congregation-of God" / "Camps-of God" | "Congregation of God" / "Camps of God" | "God's Congregation" / "God's Camps" | Inscription form | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS — "of God" construct throughout for consistency |

**Total disagreements: 15**
